articles.summary: LONGVIEW, Texas, Nov. 10, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Friedman Industries, Incorporated (NASDAQ/GS: FRD) announced today its results of operations for the quarter ended September 30, 2025. September 30, 2025 Quarter Highlights: Net earnings of $2.2 million Sales of $152.4 million: up 43%
